correctness.rationale: An internal direct sum of cactus bridge and cycle incidence spans gives independent volume sampling under a linear isomorphism. Every unequally weighted cycle has disjoint parallelotope tiles with omitted-index probabilities proportional to 1/a_e. Exact conditional means/covariances prove the full Laplacian coefficient formula. Positive coefficients identify the edge support; bridges invert by square roots; each cycle has a unique weight inverse because t sum_e 1/(sqrt(t^2+12 c_e)-t) rises continuously from zero to infinity. The delivered checker independently integrates exact rational convex hulls for seven weight profiles in dimensions 2 and 3. Finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Recovering an entire weighted labeled graph from a single population covariance is a motivated natural identifiability question, strictly more informative than known unweighted covariance or a special one-parameter family. The proof supplies a closed-form forward law and a unique one-scalar-per-cycle constructive inverse for all positive edge lengths and arbitrary cactus block gluings, without needing the zonotope itself or its higher moments.
